config.status: experimental — NOT part of the published results
config.protocol: P-MATCHED-ENSEMBLE S1 -> S2 -> S3; information-risk ranking bridge
config.registration_rule: Written before the first ensemble run. Seeds, sample sizes, thresholds, objects and levels are frozen. No outcome-dependent tuning or exclusions.

s1.mode_coordinate: W = F_infinity^(1/2) U, with U retention eigenvectors
s1.projection: P_rho = I - rho rho^T/(rho^T rho), applied identically on both covariance sides and to every sample
s1.primary_s1_denominator: analytic ideal sigma^2 F_infinity^-1; separately verify an independent ideal Gaussian baseline ensemble
s1.proper_nuisance_covariance: support-preserving factor Sigma_phi = L L^T; never use pinv(Sigma_phi) as profiling precision

openillumination.level_units: log-intensity SD = level; EACH tangent-coordinate SD = level degrees (converted to radians)
openillumination.selection: sorted uniform samples without replacement, RNG SeedSequence([scene_seed, object_index]); lights sampled first, then masked pixels; no resampling on failure
openillumination.unidentifiable_pixels: remove only exact/nonfinite F_infinity<=0 after nominal assembly, record original and retained indices; fail if fewer than n_modes+1 remain
openillumination.scope: Real thumbnails provide the nominal geometry, weights and residual pool. S1 and S3 observations are SYNTHETIC, not new real-data measurements. Canonical loader reads all 142 thumbnails; analysis uses only the frozen subset.

s2.numerator: reuse exactly the S1 linear observation draws, matched GLS, modes and projection
s2.baseline: raw flattened nominal real residual pool, iid with replacement over observations, no recentering and no degrees-of-freedom correction; zero-nuisance ideal GLS
s2.report: R2 = R1 * (b_ideal / b_boot_population) * (b_boot_population / b_boot_empirical); report per-mode factors and geometric-mean closure, not a product of medians

s3.generator: rho * relu(n dot sphere_exp(d, tangent_phi)) * exp(logI_phi) + the SAME Gaussian measurement noise as S1
s3.paired_draws: reuse exactly S1 nuisance and measurement seeds; no truncation of Gaussian draws
s3.estimator: same frozen nominal marginal GLS as S1/S2; only replace the observation-side first-order forward perturbation by the finite physical forward model
s3.denominator: reuse the exact S2 bootstrap baseline samples
s3.report: R3 = R2 * (v_nonlinear / v_linear); separate centered variance, mean and second moment; report RMS/max physical draws and shadow changes
s3.historical_boundary: Historical amplitude uses fixed real images, estimator-side assumed-light corruption, plug-in per-pixel GLS, and random-axis/scalar-angle perturbations. S3 is not that estimator or ensemble and does not explain away the historical 53.744.
s3.radius_scope: Levels 0.1 and 0.35 lie below the first historical 2x radius crossings for the selected objects (read-only reference only). A historical radius for a different estimator/endpoint does not certify this S3 experiment.

bridge.heterogeneity: SD multipliers exp(linspace(-0.7,0.7,n_lights)), normalized to RMS 1; fixed active-light order, not fitted to errors

equal_budget_subsets.construction: partition the 16 selected active lights by local index modulo 4; fail rather than replace an all-dark light

bridge.endpoint_H: P_rho / sqrt(n_pixels) for gauge-aligned linear-albedo MSE; SAME H for every plan and both families within a scene
bridge.sampling_radius: exact Gaussian quadratic-form concentration with a union bound over all matched plan risks; no plug-in SEM advertised as a certificate
bridge.ranking_rule: strict pairwise gap > sum of error radii; all pairs gives Spearman=1; partial margins give a rank-displacement lower bound; no margin means no unconditional threshold
bridge.diagnostics: reuse family_e_diag S_pred/S_real, fit_anc/fit_het and cross_ah/cross_ha definitions; do not infer causal exclusion from ranks alone
bridge.real_pipeline: existing allocation_mode_tail.arm_metrics on FIXED independently loaded DiLiGenT images, with historical scalar-angle corruption; report albedo MSE, dual energy and angular drift separately
bridge.scope: Independent DiLiGenT nominal-design synthetic Gaussian validation plus a separately labelled actual-image estimator-side diagnostic. This is not an OI holdout claim, full-cohort transfer claim, real recalibration, or proof that normal angular error is the same H endpoint. GT normals are used only for absolute nominal sanity.

finite_sample_impossibility.statement: For any finite N and distinct positive Gaussian variances, independent sample mean squared errors have positive densities on (0,infinity). Every reversed-rank open region therefore has positive probability even with exact matching.

wrong_H.failed_condition: The endpoint operator differs: H!=G; normal angular drift and aligned-albedo MSE likewise cannot silently share H.

historical_read_only.interpretation: 原始预测为1/rho；同投影线性预测只匹配坐标，经验分母仍为残差bootstrap。幅值比接近1或偏离1均不能单独验证或反驳完整匹配GLS定理。

fields.inference_boundary: S_pred/S_real reused descriptively; high S_pred alone does not logically exclude covariance misspecification or endpoint mismatch

metric_domain.injection: observation-side: I'(k,p) = rho_hat(p) * max(n(p)@d2_k,0) * g(k) — full nonlinear forward, backface flips included
metric_domain.estimator: nominal-geometry whitened GLS (denominator is the fixed nominal s^2, level-independent; estimator numerical collapse removed from the metric domain, fixing audit P0-1: v1 injected corruption estimator-side and a single extreme gain dominated sum(w*m^2))
metric_domain.radius_semantics: excess factor q(level) = dev(level) / (level/level_ref)^2 over the first-order scaling; radius = first level with q > 2 / 10

conclusions.expected_quadratic_identity: E||H e||^2 = tr(H Cov(e) H^T)+||H E e||^2; matching gives sigma^2 J_H
